coreAtributes.authorTag: Embossed into the leather are the words "Official Enforcer Issue, MFD by DSG Threadworks"
coreAtributes.name: Enforcer's dress belt
coreAtributes.description: A thick leather stomach belt supported by a thinner shoulder strap. Although it once served as a sword belt, its role is now largely ceremonial.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] tighten the dress belt around [npc.her] waist and thread excess through the buckle frame before inserting the double prongs through the closest adjustment hole. [npc.she] then adjust the shoulder strap and secure it in a similar fashion.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] tighten the dress belt around [npc2.namePos] waist and thread excess through the buckle frame before inserting the double prongs through the closest adjustment hole. [npc.she] the adjust the shoulder strap and secure it in a similar fashion.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] tighten the dress belt around [npc2.namePos] waist as much as possible and hastily thread excess through the buckle frame before inserting the double prongs through the closest adjustment hole. [npc.she] then does much the same with the shoulder strap.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unbuckle [npc.her] dress belt and its shoulder strap before taking it off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] unbuckle [npc2.namePos] dress belt and its shoulder strap before taking it off.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] hastily unbuckle [npc2.namePos] dress belt and its shoulder strap before tearing the whole thing away from [npc2.namePos] waist.
